FeinwerkDashboardSegment.PluginDescription: Choose and persist a Matomo segment per dashboard widget.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.SharingMovedNotice: Dashboard sharing has moved to the separate free plugin Feinwerk Dashboard Sharing. Install it to keep sharing your dashboards.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.SharingInactiveNotice: Dashboard sharing now comes from the free plugin Feinwerk Dashboard Sharing, which is installed but not active. Activate it to keep sharing your dashboards.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.NoDashboardDefault: No default (segment chosen at the top)
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.SaveError: Could not save your change. Please try again.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.SavedReloadHint: Your change was saved. Please reload the page to see it.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.DashboardSegmentTooltip: The segment this dashboard opens with. Single widgets can have a segment of their own.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerIntro: With the free Feinwerk Connector you install, update and license Feinwerk plugins right inside Matomo.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerInstallText: Matomo downloads the connector from its Marketplace, installs it and then activates it.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerActivateText: The connector is already installed but not activated yet.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerPasswordNote: As with every plugin install, Matomo first asks for your password if you have not entered it recently.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerManual: This Matomo cannot install plugins from its Marketplace by itself. To install the connector by hand:
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerManualStep2: Unzip it and put the folder FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector into the plugins directory of your Matomo.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3: Activate the connector under Administration, Plugins.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3Console: Plugin administration is switched off in this Matomo, so activate the connector on the command line:
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerConsole: The connector is already installed, but plugin administration is switched off in this Matomo. Activate it on the command line:
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerPhp: The Feinwerk Connector needs PHP %s or newer. Once your server runs it, you can install the connector here.
FeinwerkDashboardSegment.ConnectorInstallerWordPress: In Matomo for WordPress the Feinwerk Connector is installed as a WordPress plugin: open Matomo Analytics, Marketplace in WordPress and search for Feinwerk.
